description: This Java source file defines the DirectoryEntryAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying directory entries in an Android application. It manages a list of DirectoryEntry objects, inflates item views, and binds directory data to the views, including differentiating between directories and files based on MIME type.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying directory entries with filenames and MIME types, including icons based on entry type.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class holding references to the views within each directory entry item.

methods.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing with an empty list of directory entries.

methods.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter(List<DirectoryEntry>)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a provided list of directory entries.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a ViewHolder for a new item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds directory entry data to the ViewHolder, setting text and appropriate icons based on MIME type.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of directory entries.

methods.name: setDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Updates the list of directory entries displayed by the adapter.
